agreementDetails.confidentiality: The undersigned, in their individual capacity and as representatives of G.D Societa per Azioni ("G.D"), hereby agree not to disclose any information received from R. J. Reynolds Tobacco Company ("RJR") with respect to RJR's development of a new product (hereinafter referred to as "Project CAL") or the existence or nature of RJR's discussions with G.D concerning new package design concepts for Project CAL, to any third party or to any other employee of G.D without the prior written consent of RJR.
